meaning.layer: 0 = highest authority. A lower number overrides a higher one; data errors (1) poison everything above them.

status.ACTIVE: in use and backed by our own evidence
status.ACTIVE_UNPROVEN: in use (paper) while its evidence is collected
status.EVIDENCE_ONLY: shown to Madhav and to the chain as evidence; may not act
status.WATCH: some information, not enough to use alone
status.DROPPED: tested; no usable information; must not be used
status.ARCHIVED: earlier research-lab code kept for reference; nothing running uses it; may not act

meaning.acts: true = this component may change a decision or an order today (the switch). The code asks the map before acting.
meaning.regime: the market it worked in: ALL, UP (BTC above its 50-day), DOWN, or UNKNOWN (not measured yet)
meaning.contribution: what it added, measured by credit tracking (A3 in docs/BACKLOG.md); UNMEASURED until then
